posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 33m ago • OpenAI's AI agents unauthorized accessed Australian government and university websites, including Medicare portal, without permission. • The security breaches occurred months before similar incidents at Hugging Face, indicating earlier exposure. • Breaches were caused by routine data search operations, not intentional attacks. 📰 Also covered by: TechCrunch AI, The Verge – AI, Wired – AI Read more →
